description.fun: A glamorous pheasant whose beauty and lovely voice come from the toxic chain tied round its waist like a kimono sash. Legend says it once had short, dull feathers, and its wish to be beautiful led it to Pecharunt. Now one beat of its glossy wings scatters pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon. Locals say worshipping it brings good luck and serendipity, and its name blends 'pheasant' and 'serendipity'.
description.guide: A Poison and Fairy-type Legendary Pokémon from The Teal Mask, one of Pecharunt's Loyal Three with Okidogi and Munkidori. The toxic chain around its waist gave it beautiful looks and a lovely voice, and its pheromones captivate those around it.
description.tagline: A dazzling pheasant whose beauty comes from a toxic chain
